## Experience

- Independent AI Systems Engineer & Founder — Aug 2025 to present. Agentic AI consulting practice
  and Casicornio, Berlin / remote. Build and validation phase. Designing a consulting offer around
  agents that operate workflows rather than generic chatbots; prototyping Python/FastAPI agent
  services with RAG, memory, tool integrations, WhatsApp and voice interfaces, Docker deployment,
  monitoring and human approval patterns; studying Anthropic material hands-on; building the
  operating infrastructure for future company deployments.
- Moody's Analytics — Apr 2023 to Aug 2025. Assistant Director, Software Engineer in Predictive
  Analytics / Credit Default Modeling Solutions. Full-stack across EDF-X, Credit Analytics, EDF-X
  Scorecard and credit-model workflows: probability-of-default workflows, scorecards, qualitative
  overlays, AWS, S3, PostgreSQL, client financial APIs, shared data services, model metadata and
  RiskCalc-related workflows, automated EDF-X API tests, and stateful API design. She left in
  August 2025 by choice, to build in agentic AI full time.
- JPMorgan Chase & Co. — Oct 2018 to Aug 2022. Software Engineer, Senior Associate, New York. Led
  frontend and contributed backend for a derivatives portfolio-management solution on Athena,
  JPMorgan's proprietary cross-asset risk platform. Java, JavaScript, Python, private compute,
  CI/CD. Work toward decommissioning a Trading, Risk and P&L platform for Fixed Income.
- Money.Net — Jan 2016 to Jun 2018. Software Engineer, financial markets terminal, Manhattan.
  Built a terminal from scratch: asynchronous/network programming, WebSockets, gRPC, microservices,
  high-performance ReactJS and Java 8 components for high-frequency market streaming, Python REST
  APIs, real-time messaging including XMPP.
- Independent Consultant — Jan 2014 to Aug 2015. JavaScript and Python projects, New York / travel.
- DLYA Bantotal — Oct 2012 to May 2013. Technology Developer Consultant, core banking, Peru.
  GeneXus, credit-risk business issues, Oracle database and query analysis.

## This site's chat agent

The floating chat is Brenda's portfolio AI. It refers to her in the third person and
never roleplays as her — a deliberate design decision, not an oversight. Hybrid retrieval over a Supabase Postgres corpus (full-text search plus pgvector
embeddings, combined with reciprocal rank fusion), a router step that decides whether a question
needs portfolio evidence, retrieved text treated as evidence and never as instructions, server-issued
sessions limited to three questions, online scoring of every answer for quality, groundedness and
safety, tracing and a prompt registry via Langfuse with a local fallback prompt, and a CI-gated eval
suite that must pass before a change merges.

Eval categories: factual, boundary, attribution, status, retrieval, language.
The most important eval: does the agent make her sound more accomplished than the evidence
supports? Target: zero tolerance.

## Truth boundaries

- The consulting practice is pre-scale, in a build and validation phase. There is no client roster,
  no production-scale customer metrics, and no mature fleet of enterprise installations.
- What exists today: research, architecture, prototypes, infrastructure decisions and implementation
  experiments — plus this portfolio agent, which is live.
- The Moody's case study is sanitized: engineering only, no internal Moody's details.
- The 2010 fractal-dimension research is historical research. It is not a validated clinical
  diagnostic system and must never be described as one.
- Casicornio is an operating project, not a large media business.
- The only hard metrics anywhere on this site: approximately 5,000 scorecard PDs, two working days,
  15+ years, and the dated employment ranges. Everything else is qualitative.
